episodes.197698: A negatively tilted upper level trough approached aloft while an associated surface low's triple point passed just north of the area. Severe thunderstorms formed along the cold front and produced damaging wind gusts the night of New Year's Eve into the early morning of New Year's Day.

episodes.197720: An area of low pressure tracking from the Ohio Valley into the Middle Atlantic region bring a strong cold front through the region in the evening and overnight hours. Ahead of the cold front, a batch of strong to severe storms tracked into the Triad region and across the northern Piedmont and northern Coastal Plain. Golf ball size hail was reported in Granville County.
episodes.197897: A cold front intersected an unseasonably warm and humid airmass across the Mid-Atlantic, resulting in bands of thunderstorms that produced localized gusty to damaging winds and some hail.
